hero.headline: Manage Your Images with <1>AI-Powered Intelligence</1>
hero.description: Search, clean up, and gain insights from your image collection with privacy-first, on-device AI technology.

features.section_desc: PicetaAI combines cutting-edge AI with intuitive design to transform how you manage your images.
features.smart_search_desc: Find any image instantly with text or image-based search powered by AI.
features.smart_search_content: Search by describing what you're looking for or upload a similar image to find matches in your collection.
features.natural_language_desc: Search your images using everyday language and conversational queries.
features.natural_language_content: Ask "Show me beach photos from last summer" or "Find pictures with my dog" and get instant, accurate results.
features.duplicate_cleanup_desc: Automatically identify and remove duplicate or similar images.
features.duplicate_cleanup_content: Free up storage space and keep your collection organized with intelligent duplicate detection.
features.ai_chat_desc: Chat with AI to gain insights about your image collection and organization.
features.ai_chat_content: Ask questions about your photos and get intelligent answers about content, patterns, and organization.

quality.section_desc: Our state-of-the-art AI evaluates your images based on both aesthetic and technical factors, all while running completely on your device for maximum privacy.
quality.aesthetic_desc: Analyzes composition, color harmony, and visual appeal
quality.technical_desc: Measures sharpness, noise levels, and exposure accuracy
quality.comparative_desc: Ranks similar images to identify the highest quality version
quality.recommendations_desc: Suggests which images to keep based on quality scores
quality.why_desc: When you take multiple similar photos, it can be challenging to decide which one to keep. PicetaAI's Image Quality Assessment eliminates the guesswork by objectively analyzing each image and providing a quality score. This helps you maintain only the best images in your collection, saving storage space while preserving your most valuable memories.

how.section_desc: Discover how PicetaAI makes finding and managing your images effortless.
how.describe_desc: Use natural language to describe what you're looking for or upload a similar image.
how.ai_desc: Our on-device AI analyzes your request and searches through your image collection.
how.instant_desc: Get accurate results instantly, with no data ever leaving your device.

testimonials.alex_content: PicetaAI has completely transformed how I organize my photo library.
